quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.text: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving.

quotes.author: Maya Angelou
quotes.text: You will face many defeats in life, but never let yourself be defeated.

quotes.author: Nelson Mandela
quotes.text: It always seems impossible until it’s done.

quotes.author: A.A. Milne
quotes.text: People say nothing is impossible, but I do nothing every day.

quotes.author: Jack Handey
quotes.text: Before you criticize someone, you should walk a mile in their shoes. That way when you criticize them, you are a mile away from them and you have their shoes.

quotes.author: Amy Poehler
quotes.text: There's power in looking silly and not caring that you do.

quotes.author: Dolly Parton
quotes.text: The way I see it, if you want the rainbow, you gotta put up with the rain.

quotes.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.
quotes.text: If I cannot do great things, I can do small things in a great way.

quotes.author: Amelia Earhart
quotes.text: The most difficult thing is the decision to act; the rest is merely tenacity.

quotes.author: Jimmy Dean
quotes.text: I can't change the direction of the wind, but I can adjust my sails to always reach my destination.

quotes.author: Muhammad Ali
quotes.text: If my mind can conceive it, if my heart can believe it, then I can achieve it.

quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt
quotes.text: Believe you can and you're halfway there.

quotes.author: Fred Rogers
quotes.text: There’s no person in the whole world like you, and I like you just the way you are.

quotes.author: Wayne Gretzky
quotes.text: You miss 100% of the shots you don’t take.

quotes.author: Franklin Delano Roosevelt
quotes.text: The only limit to our realization of tomorrow is our doubts of today.

quotes.author: Winston Churchill
quotes.text: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: It is the courage to continue that counts.

quotes.author: Confucius
quotes.text: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
